name: Sudan
value: UN: 1,630+ civilians killed by drones Jan–Oct
summary: UN says drone strikes killed over 1,630 Sudanese civilians in Jan–Oct; the army is pushing towards RSF-held Al Nuhud
state: A UN Human Rights Office report on 18 Nov said drone strikes killed more than 1,630 civilians in Sudan from January to October, about 73% of 2,230 verified civilian deaths, with Kordofan the worst hit (The National). The army said it took Al Saatat on 16 Nov and was reported within about 60km of RSF-held Al Nuhud on 17 Nov, and a rights group said an army air attack killed 13 in western Sudan (Al Jazeera, 16 Nov). Mass civilian deaths and famine in parts of the country keep the Alert.
for_you: Aid agencies report famine in parts of Sudan and mass displacement. UK nationals should follow FCDO advice against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty attacks and famine reported; UN verified 1,630+ civilian drone deaths Jan–Oct 2026
